# Quantum Powerhouse

Quantum computing you can operate: a statevector and density matrix engine
running in the browser, 26 interactive instruments, a primary source verified
research study, and reference sections where every claim names the paper it
was read from. Nothing renders that was not computed.

Site: https://quantum.sadeqi.me
Author: Said Mohaddes Sadeqi (https://quantum.sadeqi.me/builder)
Source: https://github.com/Quantum-Powerhouse/QP-Core

## Machine readable data

- https://quantum.sadeqi.me/glossary.json (terms with the instrument that computes each)
- https://quantum.sadeqi.me/field/claims.json (every field claim: status, date, source URL)
- https://quantum.sadeqi.me/playground/arcade/games.json (the instrument registry)
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sadeqisaidmohaddes-star/quantum-cicd-research/master/research/evidence.json (the research evidence record)

## Key pages

- /research: the CI/CD gap study (claims, evidence, prior art, gap analysis, paper, replication)
- /field: sourced reference sections (hardware, algorithms, PQC, timeline, networking, sensing, and more)
- /playground/arcade: 26 games and labs computed by the in browser engine
- /lab: a five qubit circuit sandbox with exact state, noise, and OpenQASM export
- /learn: a guided path through the instruments
- /glossary: definitions linked to the instrument that computes each term
- /engineering: the tradeoffs behind the build, including a false claim found and removed

## Statements about accuracy

Claims marked verified were checked against their primary source, opened
directly. Vendor figures stay labeled vendor reported; preprints stay labeled
preprint. Sampled statistics carry standard errors. Anything the site cannot
do yet says so in place of pretending.
